address: 32A avenue des Carrés - à Annecy-le-Vieux, Annecy, 74940, France
bio: Mathilde and Remi work together like clockwork. He is in charge of savoury dishes, she crafts the desserts and together they cheerfully wait at table. Market-fresh, throbbingly simple, deftly executed cuisine, illustrated by melt-in-the-mouth chuck beef stew with fluffy mashed potatoes. A few seats at the bar offer an insight into the chefs’ handiwork....
